title: a subagent-tier build with a non-empty skills_first, mcp or requires is a catalog error: exit 3, the file and the field named
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (tier matrix: skills_first, mcp and requires must be empty in a subagent-tier build)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-11, tier fields; docs/decisions.md). A subagent runs inside its worker's session, so it cannot start its own skills or MCP servers and takes no launch fields: skills_first, mcp and requires must be empty. The overlay jitso/builds/plan.yaml is a copy of the fixture's plan, with one of its fields set to a value the allowlists accept. That is an invalid catalog entry: exit 3, nothing on stdout, a stderr that names jitso/builds/plan.yaml and says `<field> must be empty in a subagent-tier build`.
